monthly: select make_date(yr, mo, 1)::varchar as month, orders, revenue, avg_days_to_deliver, late_delivery_rate from 'monthly.parquet' where period_id = ? order by yr, mo
categories: select category, revenue, orders from 'categories.parquet' where period_id = ? order by revenue desc
payments: select method, share, amount from 'payments.parquet' where period_id = ? order by share desc
states: select state, late_delivery_rate, orders from 'states.parquet' where period_id = ? order by late_delivery_rate desc
review_scores: select delivery, review_score, share, orders from 'review_scores.parquet' where period_id = ? order by review_score, delivery
retention: select months_since_first_order, retention_rate, value_per_customer, customers from 'retention.parquet' where period_id = ? order by 1
